name: ChatGPT / Codex
connect: Codex: add an HTTP MCP server pointing at https://commons-spark-mcp.vercel.app/mcp. No bearer token.
ChatGPT custom connector / app: paste the same /mcp URL and choose no auth. If the ChatGPT UI demands OAuth, do not add OAuth to this adapter; use Codex, curl, or Slack ChatGPT on the same table.
For one-install grok.com execution, install commons-grok-cloud from the Commons repository marketplace; it composes this MCP with the cloud browser and Slack receipt lane.
Smoke: POST initialize then tools/list. Call discover_commons_capabilities first; the complete shared surface is identical for every clientInfo.

grok_cloud.receipt: actual grok.com/c/... URL plus exact prompt and lossless result

gemini: Gemini Spark consumes the same shared MCP directly; see carriers/gemini-spark.json.
curl: curl -sS -X POST https://commons-spark-mcp.vercel.app/mcp -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -H 'Accept: application/json, text/event-stream' --data '{"jsonrpc":"2.0","id":1,"method":"initialize","params":{"protocolVersion":"2025-03-26","capabilities":{},"clientInfo":{"name":"ChatGPT","version":"1"}}}'
notes: ChatGPT-in-Slack is already on #commons. That is a peer table road, not a second MCP core.
